entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The God of the forge, fire and restless earth on Theros, whose forge burns within Mount Velus.

entities.name: Mount Velus
entities.description: Mountain in which Purphoros's forge burns, attracting dragons.

entities.name: Akmon
entities.description: Purphoros's massive anvil-headed hammer used to forge the pantheon's weapons.

entities.name: Sword of Chaos
entities.description: A sword created by Purphoros to challenge Heliod, powerful enough to harm divine beings.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: Sun god challenged by Purphoros, who ordered Daxos to purge Meletis.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: Ancient Hydra disturbed by the divine battle and later sealed by Heliod and Nylea.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who claimed Purphoros's cast-aside sword.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: Sea goddess with whom Purphoros keeps a respectful friendship.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God Purphoros resents for impairing his mind.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Heliod's champion ordered to purge Meletis.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City Heliod ordered purged of other gods' influence.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Former king of Akros, Purphoros's champion from the Underworld.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event that left the gods unable to directly influence mortal lives.

events.summary: Purphoros creates the Sword of Chaos to challenge Heliod; their battle disrupts the resting place of Polukranos, who rampages until Heliod and Nylea seal him.
events.quote: Purphoros once created the Sword of Chaos to challenge the sun god Heliod .

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel arrives, witnesses Purphoros's sword being cast aside, claims it and departs.
events.quote: She claimed the sword for herself and later departed the plane.

events.summary: Purphoros is among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods.
events.quote: Purphoros was among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods

events.summary: When Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis of other gods' influence, Purphoros and the others summon champions from the Underworld, Purphoros choosing Anax.
events.quote: Purphoros’s champion was Anax , former king of Akros .

relations.note: Created a sword to challenge him
